integration_issues.issue: mobile-episode-chapters is nested INSIDE EpisodeVideoBlock (renders only when media.video_url is present). For an audio-only episode where creator has saved chapters via PUT /chapters, listeners never see the tappable chapters. Spec suggests chapters should be usable with audio too (creator UI saves them regardless of media_type). Consider decoupling the chapters block from the video block so it renders whenever chapters.length>0.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/creator_video.py:76 — content-type check `if video.content_type and video.content_type not in _VIDEO_TYPES` will PASS uploads that omit Content-Type entirely (curl -F without type). Consider `if not video.content_type or video.content_type not in _VIDEO_TYPES` OR sniff by extension.

backend/routes/creator_video.py:79 — key includes uuid.uuid4() so each upload creates a NEW Tigris object; previous video_storage_key is orphaned (not deleted). Consider `st.delete(key=old_key)` before overwrite to avoid Tigris cost drift.

backend/routes/creator_video.py — no duration_seconds computed on upload. Media response returns duration from stored field; UI shows '—' unless creator sets duration_sec manually. Consider ffprobe / mediainfo (or client-side) to populate it.

backend/routes/merchant_marketplace.py:672-675 — impression accounting per item runs inside the response path (not fire-and-forget as the comment claims). Under load this doubles the Mongo write count per GET /api/discovery/featured. Consider BackgroundTasks or batching.

mobile/app/podcast/episode/[id].tsx:317 — StyleSheet has `transcriptText: {...},  backBtn: {...}` on a single line — cosmetic but easy to miss.

rca of the issue: Consumer chapters not rendering on audio-only episodes — RCA: /app/mobile/app/podcast/episode/[id].tsx EpisodeVideoBlock function (~line 260) contains BOTH the video player AND the chapters list. It early-returns `null` when `!ExpoVideo?.VideoView || !player`, and `player` is only created via `ExpoVideo.useVideoPlayer(media.video_url, ...)` which needs a video URL. Consumer podcast_episode/{id}/media therefore never surfaces chapters for audio-only episodes even though PUT /chapters saves them just fine. Fix: extract the chapters map into its own component gated on `chapters.length > 0` (not on video presence).
